title:
Tenants Meeting 10.09.24 📖

We had a great turn out yesterday, thank you to Newbarn Ltd for joining us! 

We discussed the winter flu vaccinations, recycling and bin collections. Our plans for the festive season 🎁 Tenants also shared their choices for holidays and days out in 2025! 

Service user/tenant involvement is the process of people who use or have used a service in the planning, development, and delivery of that service. It's a way to ensure that the voices of service users /tenants are heard and that they can help shape and improve the services they use ✂️📍📌📊
